newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai foreign investment 57 pct in industry.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai foreign investment 57 pct in industry.

text.p: Of total foreign-invested projects in Shanghai in the first half, 57.1 percent flowed into industrial projects, the China Business Times said on Monday.
Foreign-funded projects in the real estate and public utilities accounted for 17.45 percent of the total, it said.
The newspaper did not give total projects or the contracted amount for the period, but said 95 foreign-funded projects involved investment of more than $10 million each.
